sources.finding: Copilot uses the saved Simplify profile and requires signing in to the installed extension. The recommended test route is a supported application opened from Simplify jobs.
Normal operation opens a supported application, uses the Simplify panel, invokes Autofill This Page, and requires review before user submission.
The article links to simplify.jobs/demo as a pinning demonstration.
Actual Chrome UI exposes extension installation and registration/login links; inspected DOM has zero forms and zero input/textarea/select nodes.

Actual Chrome UI shows a four-step instructional walkthrough. Step3 describes profile-driven autofill and displays a screenshot. DOM has zero forms, zero input/textarea/select nodes, and zero iframes.
The connected Chrome session rendered the login page with email/password, SSO actions, Sign in and a reCAPTCHA region. No credential or sign-in action was used.

browser_observations.browser: Existing connected Chrome, selected through CUA browser1

installed_extension.reason: Only http and https protocols allowed. Tool explicitly forbids workaround, indirect execution, alternate browser surfaces and policy circumvention.

permitted_actions_actually_taken: Read normal browser inventory without retaining unrelated tab metadata
practical_normal_user_route: Use an owner-prepared Simplify evaluation account/profile containing exactly the approved synthetic comparison facts.
Have the owner authenticate through normal service and extension UI; credentials, MFA and CAPTCHA remain outside this agent task.
Confirm the installed Copilot version through a permitted normal UI or owner-provided observation.
Open the same supported public form and synthetic input used by the candidate comparison.

Use normal Copilot Autofill This Page interaction, manually record field-by-field writes, persistence, errors, uncertainty, required omissions, timing and corrections, and never activate final submit.
limitations: The inspected public demo is not an executable same-input autofill sandbox. This finding is limited to the official linked demo and product page, not proof that no other demonstration exists.
Rendering the web login page does not prove that no separate extension token exists. Installed extension and its authentication state remain unknown.
No real/private profile data was accessed, substituted for synthetic input, copied or written.
No private Simplify code, authenticated DOM/CSS, private API or extracted assets were copied.
Readiness observations are not competitor benchmark outcomes and do not satisfy Gate A comparison thresholds.
